title: “Anna” by Lucio Battisti
text: Lucio Battisti was an Italian singer-songwriter and composer. He is widely recognized for songs that defined the late 1960s and 1970s era of Italian songwriting.

title: “Vent'anni” by Massimo Ranieri
text: "Vent'anni" is a 1970 Italian song composed by Giancarlo Bigazzi, Enrico Polito and Totò Savio and performed by Massimo Ranieri. The song won the eighth edition of Canzonissima, beating Gianni Morandi's "Capriccio" and establishing Ranieri as the new favorite of the Italian younger audience.

title: “Il cuore e' uno zingaro” by Nicola Di Bari
text: "Il cuore è uno zingaro" is a song composed by Claudio Mattone (music) and Franco Migliacci (lyrics). The song won the twenty-first edition of the Sanremo Music Festival, with a double performance by Nicola Di Bari and Nada.

title: “4/3/1943” by Lucio Dalla
text: "4/3/1943", also spelled "4 marzo 1943", is a 1971 song composed by Lucio Dalla and Paola Pallottino. The song ranked third at the 21st edition of the Sanremo Music Festival, in a double performance by Lucio Dalla and Equipe 84.

title: “Love Story” by Francis Lai
text: Francis Albert Lai was a French composer, noted for his film scores. He won the 1970 Oscar for Best Music, Original Score and the Golden Globe Award for Best Original Score for the film Love Story.

title: “Pensieri e parole” by Lucio Battisti
text: "Pensieri e parole" is a 1971 song composed by Lucio Battisti (music) and Mogol (lyrics), arranged by Gian Piero Reverberi and performed by Lucio Battisti. The song consists of an inner dialogue with himself, addressed with two different melodic lines that intersect with each other.

title: “Tanta voglia di lei” by Pooh
text: "Tanta voglia di lei" is a 1971 song composed by Roby Facchinetti and Valerio Negrini and performed by the Italian musical group Pooh.

title: “Amore caro amore bello” by Bruno Lauzi
text: Bruno Lauzi was an Italian singer-songwriter, poet and writer.
listen: Amore caro amore bello Bruno Lauzi

title: “Mamy Blue” by Pop Tops
text: "Mamy Blue" is a 1970 song by French songwriter Hubert Giraud. Originally written with French lyrics, the song was rendered in English in 1971 to become an international hit for the Pop-Tops, Joël Daydé and Roger Whittaker.

title: “Pensiero” by Pooh
text: "Pensiero" is a 1971 song composed by Roby Facchinetti and Valerio Negrini. It is performed by the Italian musical group Pooh.
